name: Fstyle Honeypot Bot Blocker
author: fstylegear09543

sections.description:
Stop malicious bots and scanners instantly using a smart honeypot trap.

Protect your website from unauthorized crawlers and malicious bots that ignore your site’s robots.txt directives. Fstyle Honeypot Bot Blocker provides a lightweight yet powerful security layer by automatically detecting and blocking intruders.

Once installed, it sets a hidden trap path in your robots.txt. If a bot attempts to access this forbidden area, its IP address is immediately captured and blocked from accessing your entire site.

It also treats the paths that scanners probe first (.env, .git, credentials.json, phpinfo.php, wp-config.php backups, vendor/phpunit, phpMyAdmin) as traps. A normal WordPress site never serves these files, so the scanner is stopped on its first request, before it tries anything else.

It can also protect Contact Form 7 forms with a hidden field and a fill-in timer (off by default). Nothing is sent to an outside service.

Features

  • Instant Honeypot Block: Automatically adds a trap path to your robots.txt.
  • Scanner Path Traps: Blocks bots that probe .env, .git, key files, phpinfo, wp-config backups, phpunit and phpMyAdmin (can be turned off).
  • Your Own Traps: Add extra trap paths from the settings screen.
  • Contact Form 7 Protection (off by default): A hidden field and a fill-in timer stop bot submissions without reCAPTCHA. Choose Off, Log only or Block.
  • IP Management Dashboard: View detailed logs of blocked IP addresses and manage them easily.
  • Smart Whitelist: Add trusted service IPs to prevent accidental lockouts.
  • Ultra-Lightweight: Built for performance with minimal database impact.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fstyle-honeypot-bot-blocker folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access settings via the “Fstyle Blocker” menu in your dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does it protect Contact Form 7 forms?

Yes, from version 1.4.0, but the Contact Form 7 protection is off by default. Turn it on in “Fstyle Blocker” > “Contact Form 7 Protection”. It adds a hidden field (people never see it, bots often fill it in) and records the time from opening the page to sending the form. A submission that fills in the hidden field, is sent faster than the shortest time (3 seconds by default), or is sent without JavaScript is treated as spam by Contact Form 7, and the visitor sees Contact Form 7’s spam message.

What is “Log only”?

The messages are still sent, and the plugin only counts the submissions it would have blocked. Use it for a while to compare with your current spam protection (for example reCAPTCHA) before switching to “Block”.

Does it send data to an outside service?

No. The check runs on your server. Only daily counts and the latest detections (time, form ID and reason, no personal data) are kept in your site’s options.

I use a page cache. Do I need to do anything?

Clear the page cache after turning the protection on, so that cached pages include the new fields. Forms on pages cached before that are not judged (they are counted as “Not judged”). The timer is written by JavaScript in the browser, so cached pages keep working.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • New: Contact Form 7 protection with a hidden field and a fill-in timer (3 seconds by default). Off by default. Modes: Off, Log only, Block.
  • Blocked submissions are treated as spam by Contact Form 7 (spam log), and the guard fields are kept out of mail and stored data.
  • Daily counts and the latest detections are shown on the settings screen. Nothing is sent outside your site.

1.3.0

  • New: common scanner paths (.env, .git, .aws, credentials.json, service-account.json, info.php / phpinfo.php, wp-config.php backups, vendor/phpunit, phpMyAdmin) are now traps. On by default, can be turned off in Trap Settings (filter: fstyle_honeypot_scanner_patterns).
  • New: add your own trap paths in Trap Settings.
  • Sites installed in a sub folder match traps relative to the site path.

1.2.0

  • Security: the trap now matches only the URL path (a trap word in the query string no longer blocks the visitor).
  • Blocks now expire after 7 days (filter: fstyle_honeypot_block_days).
  • Verified Googlebot / Bingbot (reverse and forward DNS) are never blocked.
  • Logged-in administrators are never blocked on the front end.

1.1.1

  • Refreshed admin interface for better visibility.
  • Added <code> tag wrapper for IP addresses.
  • Integrated empty log state handler.
  • Enhanced screenshot for Plugin Directory.

1.1

  • Improved security: added SQL prepare statements and output escaping.
  • Fixed “Short Description missing” warning for WordPress.org compliance.
  • Updated readme metadata for WordPress 6.9 compatibility.

1.0

  • Initial release.
